title: Service NSW Mobile App
summary: This page provides information on downloading and using the Service NSW mobile app.
what_you_need: A device running Android version 9.x (Pie) and higher or iOS 15.5 and higher.
A MyServiceNSW email address and password to log in.

internal_links.text: How to create a MyServiceNSW Account

faqs.q: What operating systems are supported by the Service NSW app?
faqs.a: The app supports Android version 9.x (Pie) and higher, and iOS 15.5 and higher.

faqs.q: How do I check for and install an app update?
faqs.a: Open the Service NSW app, select Settings, and scroll down to see the Version number. If an update is available, an update button will appear.

faqs.q: How do I log in to my MyServiceNSW Account using the app?
faqs.a: Open the Service NSW app, select Settings, then select the Log in button. Enter your MyServiceNSW email address and password and press Log in. You may need to set a PIN number the first time you log in.
